search_text: published ZDI-23-230 ZDI-CAN-19537 ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus ImageUploadServlet Improper Input Validation Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2023-03-09 CVE-2023-26601 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-26601 6.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H ['ManageEngine'] ['ServiceDesk Plus'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus. title: ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus ImageUploadServlet Improper Input Validation Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
